answer: Admission is cross-branch quorum: the beacon deals one fresh ring per operator each epoch; zenith counts keys whose seal-graphs touch as one operator, and its kth key is final only after k disjoint rings seal it, each sealer locking one hollow, forfeited if two backed keys share ring, path or signer. First key: one epoch, one hollow. n keys: n(n+1)/2 serial epochs and locked hollow; reuse collides, bribing unrelated rings is the bill.
